title: Do 20,000 random vectors catch any RTL bug that 64 missed, and do they contradict the formal equivalence proofs?
summary: A deep random draw on the 26 eda-verify mutants that 64-vector random testing never caught or flagged oddly (16 proved equivalent, 10 formal timeouts). 20,000 further uniform vectors catch none of the 25 survivors, so none contradicts a formal equivalence proof, and a random-visible bug among the 9 undecided mutants has per-vector detection probability below 1.4×10−4 (95%), sixteen times tighter than before. The one apparent failure, del@122, is a real detection at vector 0 (its done output is X, then stuck at 1); an earlier reading as truncated output was wrong, a checker parsing bug. Stylised: one design, uniform random inputs, same vector stream for every mutant.
